verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI offers conversation checkpointing to save and resume sessions (gemini-cli-gh-8), which provides a rudimentary rollback/resume mechanism, but there is no evidence of versioning, diffing, or reviewing automation scripts/workflows themselves, nor a dedicated rollback command for automations. missing for 10: explicit version history for automations, review/diff tooling, and a documented rollback mechanism beyond session checkpoints.
